name: PEA-PME
summary: A sister plan to the PEA focused on European SMEs and mid-caps, with a higher combined ceiling.

rules.name: Client is a French tax resident
rules.message: A PEA-PME can only be held by a French tax resident.
rules.explain: Only French tax residents can open or fund a PEA-PME.

rules.name: One PEA-PME per taxpayer
rules.message: This client already holds a PEA-PME ({existing}).
rules.explain: Each taxpayer may hold a single PEA-PME.

rules.name: Lifetime contribution limit
rules.message: This deposit exceeds the PEA-PME contribution limit.
rules.explain: Payments are capped at €225,000 (combined with the PEA in the real regime; simplified here).

rules.name: Instrument is an eligible EU SME
rules.message: {symbol} isn't an eligible SME or mid-cap.
rules.explain: PEA-PME only accepts EU/EEA companies below the SME / mid-cap thresholds.

rules.name: Sufficient cash in the plan
rules.message: Not enough cash in the plan. Required {required}, available {available}.
rules.explain: Purchases and withdrawals must be covered by cash held inside the wrapper.

rules.name: 5-year holding period
rules.message: The plan is {plan_age} years old. A withdrawal before year 5 closes the PEA-PME.
rules.explain: Withdrawing before the 5th anniversary closes the plan.

schedule.label: Before 5 years
schedule.note: Full rate on the gain portion; the plan closes.

schedule.label: After 5 years
schedule.note: Social charges only on the gain portion.
